split_rule: fresh canonical write-history groups; exclude all prior G5S/G8C groups before split
paired_ranking_loss: positive sequence NLL plus 0.5 hinge margin 1.0 against the other query answer
matched_control: compute both sequence scores in both arms
generation: prompt strings only, greedy, EOS required
claim_limit: memory mechanism test only; not Qwen parity or 300-800M scale-up
